policy.statement: Only a host classified as alpha-target may be offered the first installable alpha. Every other classification is refused by default. A matching classification is not a live acceptance: open gates listed below remain open until recorded on that host.

gateStatuses.passed: Observed in the real host for this target and recorded in the referenced document.
gateStatuses.passed-user-reported: Observed by the operator in the real host; no automated host check exists.
gateStatuses.partial: Some cases observed in the real host; listed cases remain open.
gateStatuses.synthetic-only: Only component or fixture checks exist; no real-host acceptance.
gateStatuses.open: Not yet observed in the real host.
gateStatuses.blocked: Cannot be observed: host or payload target missing.

gates.title: Installation of the payload into the host
Package load, menu entry and tool window opening
Docking, closing and reopening the tool window
Keyboard focus, resize and theme switching
Embedded WebView2/OpenChamber chat with a real provider reply
Distinguishing unsaved editor content from saved/snapshot text
Explicit POU attachment to a project chat
Saved-project engineering MCP in the installed host
Knowledge MCP with an operator corpus in the installed host
Two simultaneous IDE instances stay isolated
Cold start with restored PLC editors, restored Assistant pane and toolbox initialization
Normal IDE close stops owned Assistant processes
Installer update and return to the previous payload

targets.title: TwinCAT XAE Shell (VS 15.9 isolated shell, 32-bit) with TwinCAT 3.1 Build 4024

payload.notes: Discovery was established by an unpacked directory plus updating the existing marker's timestamp. /UpdateConfiguration is not supported by this shell. VSIXInstaller into the shell is untested.

install.open: Only coordinated manual copies (0.1.1-0.1.9) are recorded; installer install/update/rollback is not.

member-context.open: Member context is implemented; a recorded live member-editor acceptance per build is missing.

unsaved-content.open: Dirty status observed for one unsaved comment; exact unsaved editor-buffer text semantics are unverified.

engineering-mcp.open: Tool catalog and calls pass with synthetic projects; installed project acceptance with the operator is not recorded.

knowledge-mcp.open: Synthetic corpus only; an operator corpus in the installed host is not accepted.

multi-ide.open: Direct-reader isolation passed in a second IDE; in-process UI/chat isolation is not recorded.

cold-start-restored-editors.open: A hang while restoring PLC editors was observed without the Assistant loaded; its cause is unproven.

shutdown.open: Owned process shutdown is tested by fixtures; installed IDE close with restored pane is not recorded.
